name: Parallel-SSHI-Bridge
rationale: To address the low voltage (S2, S4) and overvoltage (S3) issues, I am replacing the passive FBR with a Parallel-SSHI (Synchronous Switch Harvesting on Inductor) topology. The L-S combination in parallel with the piezo flips the capacitor voltage at each peak, significantly increasing the energy extracted per cycle. A Zener diode (DZ33) is added to clamp the output voltage at ~3.3V, ensuring it stays below the 3.6V limit for strong excitations (S3). A larger storage capacitor (22uF) is used to minimize the peak-to-peak ripple and stabilize the output voltage across different load conditions.
